narrative:
Most Qlik users at Sport Holding work in the stores. The Store Manager Copilot gives them a governed "ask your data" view in Norwegian or English: "Hvilke skivarer går tom før uke 50?" gets an answer from POS, stock and the ML demand forecast in seconds.

It uses the same semantic model as finance, with row-level security per store, so an associated store owner sees only their own store.

signals.title: Ski stock cover in Trøndelag at 2.1 weeks before the winter peak
signals.source: SDP Inventory & Stockout Intelligence — store stock × ML demand forecast
signals.excerpt: Intersport Trondheim City Syd and Solsiden have 2.1 weeks of alpine and cross-country cover against a 6-week target before week 50. Estimated sales at risk NOK 8.6M (NOK 3.2M gross margin) unless DC stock is re-allocated from Oslo this week.
